reviewedRevision: 7ecc35f plus the rework in this commit
process: Lean final review at the user's request: the known 5-room shortfall went straight to a retrofit, followed by one independent review round. Its one MEDIUM finding (flat difficulty) and three LOW items were fixed and verified by re-running the reviewer's own pilot and blind scripts, one clean-worktree run and the browser check, without a second review round.
independentProbes: On the final files the reviewer's own pilot (enemies and arrows seen 0.35 s late, BFS routing, spike timing, windup and arrow evasion) cleared 120 of 120 chamber runs, with mastery chambers 15-20 costing 2-4 hits each and up to 3 hearts. Its no-evasion variant now cleared only 18 of 36 mastery runs, failing chambers 17, 18 and 20 every time. Blind play (idle, mash, random keys and six hold-plus-alternate periods, 8 seeds) won at most 13% of any chamber. In the review round, a 360-game hostile-input fuzz found no wall or gate overlap, non-finite value or double end; gates only open; play drifted at most 1.6 px across 30, 60 and 120 Hz; spikes hurt only in their active phase over the drawn plate; arrows were dodgeable at 0.35 s; and buffered taps never doubled an action.

findings.observation: Only 5 rooms built from per-room branches, with no select or continue. There are now 20 data-driven chambers introducing keys, sleeping guards with a windup arc, dodge-steps, timed spikes, levers and gates, archers with aim lines, chests and flasks, shrines, key-triggered ambushes and warden bosses one at a time, with accurate EN/ZH tips, a chamber select and env.progress continue; sword, dodge and flask taps are buffered, and the 1,157-line file is split into seven modules.

Review finding: difficulty was flat; a guard stagger (0.45 s) outlasted the swing cooldown (0.42 s), so chained swings beat guards risk-free and even a no-evasion bot cleared every chamber. The stagger is now 0.3 s; mastery chambers add armoured guards that finish a started windup, pack wake-ups, 1.5x enemy speed, extra guards, archers and statues, and fewer shrines and flasks, while chambers 1-14 are unchanged.
The drawn guard warning arc now covers the real hit area (+-1.2 rad, checked by a test), a corner assist slides the player into 1-wide doorways, and the chamber 12 tip mentions its spike column.

openNotes: Chambers 1-11 remain gentle by design; most of the challenge is in 15-20.
Chamber 14 starts with guards awake, so standing idle there loses.
Hearts no longer carry between chambers, so each chamber can be replayed fairly from the select.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start, the chamber select and the touch buttons, synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
